response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), s AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), r AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, share, share - avg_share AS diff_above_avg FROM r WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC
